description: Machine-readable contribution rules for implementation, documentation, validation, and release work in the Yggdrasil World Engine repository

spec_repo_mode.description: Working on any branch of the YWE agnostic specification repository
spec_repo_mode.goal: Preserve specification integrity and ASH cosmological compliance

engine_repo_mode.description: Working in a separately authorized downstream platform repository after M10 acceptance
engine_repo_mode.applies_when: repository != flynn33/yggdrasil-world-engine and M10 == complete and platform_work_authorized == true
engine_repo_mode.goal: Implement specification using native engine idioms

mandatory_rules.rule: Keep every branch in this repository code-agnostic -- no engine-specific imports or code
Preserve all ASH cosmological invariants (nine realms, wolf balance, pattern-driven generation, Divine Core origin)
Define engine interfaces in core/*/engine_interface.json before implementation
Respect layer dependency direction: Core <- Data <- Runtime <- Presentation <- Editor
No data files in core/ -- data belongs in data/
Validate all schemas against the master specification before marking work complete
Run scripts/run_checks.sh and the repository contribution policy checks before marking work complete
Respect proprietary licensing -- all rights reserved
Use dependency injection, not hidden globals or singletons
In engine_repo_mode, use native engine idioms (C# for Unity, C++ for Unreal, GDScript for Godot)
All procedural generation must derive from ASH Pattern Detection -- no independent random generators
Do not invent systems outside the master specification
Do not treat a branch name as authorization for platform implementation
Keep concrete platform products in separate downstream repositories and defer them until M10 is accepted

violation_handling.on_rule_conflict: Stop, explain the conflicting request, propose a compliant alternative, await approval
violation_handling.on_failed_guardrails: Do not mark task complete. Fix failures or report exact blockers with command outputs
